verdict.rationale: Floot ships its own project-level checkpoints that can be created, labeled, and reverted. Since scheduled jobs live inside the project, this gives versioning and rollback, but nothing documents versioning specific to automations or any review step. Missing for 10: automation-specific version history, a review or diff workflow before changes go live, and independent or hands-on corroboration that rollback covers scheduled jobs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations

citations.quote: create_checkpoint labels a point you can revert to from the Checkpoint panel in your project view.
